sloka: एवं ब्रुवाणे काकुत्स्थे क्रोधशोकसमन्विते ।ब्रह्मा सुरगणैः सार्धमुवाच रघुनन्दनम् ।। ७.९८.११ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ bruvāṇe kākutsthe krodhaśokasamanvite ।brahmā suragaṇaiḥ sārdhamuvāca raghunandanam ।। 7.98.11 ॥

translations.english: While Rama, filled with anger and sorrow, was speaking thus, Brahma, accompanied by the hosts of gods, addressed him.
